mechanisms.target_behavior: Prompt the agent near the end of a search-heavy run to stop expanding research and use the best available evidence to complete the requested response.
mechanisms.precondition: steps_left <= 2 and n('search') >= 8 and not is_finish
mechanisms.text: Only {steps_left} steps remain. Stop opening new research paths. Use the strongest evidence already available to address the specific request in a concise, complete answer; do not invent unsupported details.
